LESSON: LISTENING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.8: Listening for Information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for Information, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you improve your ability to retain information while listening?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a video clip and list the physical features highlighted with peers (山、 湖、河、洋、海、大裂谷、沙漠、森 林),

2. play a bingo game on physical features in class (i.e. learners listen to vocabulary related to physical features and on their bingo card, mark off all the words, the first person to finish must call out: ‘zhòng le!’),

3. listen to an audio on physical features and summarise the key points,

4. listen to simple descriptions of physical features and say out the physical feature that matches the description (它很 高,上面有雪),

5. research and present on challenges facing physical features within their environment and propose solutions to address them collaboratively.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a video clip and list the physical features highlighted with peers (山、 湖、河、洋、海、大裂谷、沙漠、森 林),
2. play a bingo game on physical features in class (i.e. learners listen to vocabulary related to physical features and on their bingo card, mark off all the words, the first person to finish must call out: ‘zhòng le!’),
3. listen to an audio on physical features and summarise the key points,
4. listen to simple descriptions of physical features and say out the physical feature that matches the description (它很 高,上面有雪),
5. research and present on challenges facing physical features within their environment and propose solutions to address them collaboratively.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for Information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: the learner works collaboratively with peers to propose solutions for challenges facing the physical features in

their locality.

Values:
Responsibility: the learner works with peers to identify the physical features highlighted in the video clip.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental education: this is nurtured when the learner researches, discusses and presents solutions to challenges affecting

physical features in their environment as well as identifying the physical features highlighted in the video clip.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

• The learner relates the study of physical features in their environment to Social Studies.

• The learner applies the skill of comprehensively summarising key information from texts as learnt in English and Kiswahili.
